name: Pennsylvania Junior Academy of Science (PJAS)
city: Pennsylvania (12 regions; State Meet at the Penn State main campus in 2026)
what_you_do: Do your own science research project, then give a 10 minute talk to judges at a regional meet. Students who qualify go on to the State Meet in May.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 in Pennsylvania: public, private, parochial or home schooled. You need an adult sponsor (a teacher, parent or scientist). You must do your own research and your own presentation.
pay_detail: Costs are not stated on the pages read. Check your region page for fees.
duration: Regional meets January to March; State Meet in May (2026: May 17 to 19)
deadline_text: The 2026 State Meet was May 17 to 19, 2026 at Penn State University Park. Each region sets its own deadlines. The pages read do not list 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Pick a research category. Find a sponsor. Use the Find Your Region page for your region's deadlines, forms and location. Turn in any required SRC/IRB approval forms.
notes: A science fair, not a job. Your project may need extra approval forms depending on your research field, so ask your sponsor or Regional Director early. Regional pages list the exact deadlines.
